newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Iranian minister arrives in Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: Iranian minister arrives in Bahrain.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati arrived in Bahrain on Wednesday, where officials have accused his country of backing a plot to topple the government.
Officials travelling with Velayati said he went to the Foreign Ministry shortly after arriving from Qatar.
Velayati is on a 10-country tour to deliver invitations to heads of states of Moslem countries to attend a December summit in Tehran of the Organisation of the Islamic Conference (OIC).
He has already visited Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar and Oman and was expected in the United Arab Emirates, with whom Iran is locked in a territorial dispute, later on Wednesday.
Iran's relations with its Gulf Arab neighbours are often tense. It has repeatedly denied charges of interfering in their internal affairs.

Bahrain last year accused Shi'ite Moslem Iran of backing an attempt to topple the government by force. Iran denied the charge. The trial of 81 people accused of involvement in the alleged plot started this month.
